test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
For your safety at work, which of the following should be ensured?

1. All the required protective clothing and equipment are used.

2. Training and instruction necessary for performing tasks safely have been received.
solution:
The correct answer is __Both statements 1 and 2**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Protective clothing and equipment:__ It is essential to ensure all necessary protective gear is used to mitigate workplace hazards.
 
• __Proper training and instruction:__ Employees must receive adequate training and instructions to perform tasks safely, minimizing the risk of accidents.
 
• Both factors are crucial for ensuring safety at work and creating a safe working environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Protective Equipment:**

 
 
• Protective clothing and equipment act as a barrier against workplace hazards like chemicals, sharp objects, or extreme temperatures.
 
• Examples include helmets, gloves, goggles, and safety shoes.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Training:**
 
 
• Training helps employees understand safety protocols and the proper usage of equipment.
 
• It also fosters a culture of safety and reduces workplace incidents.
 
 
 
• **Compliance with Standards:**
 
 
• Organizations must comply with occupational safety and health standards to ensure worker safety.
 
• Regular audits and reviews help maintain compliance and identify potential risks.
